notes: selection runs at native resolution — resizeTo swaps the engine handle with no selectionBind (code reading; the resample+selection seam is untested territory this page chose not to stand on)

claims.title: Retouch — clone, heal, content-aware fill
notes: clone: no landing reported by the panel
heal: no landing reported by the panel
content-aware fill → Filled the selection with noise on layer “Background” — undoable. Document unchanged; Apply to recomposite.

claims.title: Paint and the raster word
notes: finding: every solid-paint stroke committed with zero dabs (brush and pencil, default and changed colour alike) while the sample-mode clone/heal on the previous page land through identical gestures — the solid-deposit lane, which brush, pencil and raster type share, is the measured suspect
type: no glyph run reported by the panel
the painted export is byte-identical to the identity baseline — no stroke or glyph landed; the captions state it
